_doc: Shrines, the defaults for every mode that turns them on (a mode's rules "shrines" block, whose keys win over these; Capture the Flag keeps its own). A shrine is a ring on the floor: the map's "shrines" ({pos, radius, kind}), else one per "spots" entry (fractions of the floor, moved to the nearest solid floor). It is ready first after first_seconds; a team alone in it for claim_seconds claims it, and every fighter of that team on its feet gets the buff for buff_seconds (haste: walking x haste_mult; might: damage x might_mult); then it rests for cooldown_seconds. Two or more teams in it hold the claim where it is; another team alone wears an enemy claim down twice as fast before it starts its own; nobody in it lets a claim fade. announce_seconds before a shrine is ready the sim says so (shrine_soon). "kinds" (a list) cycles the kind each time a shrine is claimed (shrine i starts at kinds[i]); without it a shrine keeps the map's kind (haste when none). The CPU: the nearest fighter of each team within cpu_range px of a ready shrine, with no foe within cpu_engaged px of it, goes to claim it (sim.goals). Times are in seconds.
